title: Practice: Claude in a repository's workflow (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 the mention workflow answers only claude comments and holds no key
cases.says: The mention workflow answers only @claude comments, checks the code out, uses the stable action version, holds no key and passes the course's linter

cases.id: e1 the review workflow reads the code and posts the review
cases.says: The review workflow reads the code, runs the review skill with --comment, names the inline comment tool and installs the plugin

cases.id: e2 each prompt file carries a version that its changelog explains
cases.says: Each prompt file carries a version that the changelog's newest entry matches

cases.id: e3 the review guidance and the git workflow are files the reviewer and claude read
cases.says: The review guidance and the git workflow are files with the required sections

cases.id: e4 every run is bounded by turns time and concurrency
cases.says: Every run is bounded by turns, time and concurrency, and a new push replaces a running review

cases.id: e5 no file holds a key a personal path or an address
cases.says: No file holds a key, a personal path or an address
